chunks: Tell them: 'Come, I will read out what your Lord has made binding on you: That you make none the equal of God, and be good to your parents, and do not abandon your children out of poverty, for We give you food and We shall provide for them; and avoid what is shameful, whether open or hidden, and do not take a life which God has forbidden, unless for some just cause. These things has God enjoined on you. Haply you may understand.'
ai.seo_question: What are the key moral and theological commands given by God in Surah Al-An'am verse 151?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Verse of the Essentials' (Ayat al-Masa'il), this passage is central to Shia jurisprudence as it provides the foundational framework for the six primary duties derived directly from the Quran. The Imam al-Sadiq (AS) famously cited this verse to demonstrate that the core tenets of Islam are explicitly enumerated in the scripture, linking theological monotheism with practical social ethics such as filial piety and the sanctity of life.
